title: super-net: trustworthy image segmentation via uncertainty propagation in encoder-decoder networks
core_idea: Introduce Super-Net, a Bayesian framework for encoder-decoder image segmentation that propagates the posterior mean and covariance through nonlinear layers using Taylor series approximations to produce both a segmented image and a pixel-wise uncertainty map without Monte Carlo sampling.
tldr: A method to make encoder-decoder segmentation models trustworthy by efficiently propagating uncertainty (mean and covariance) through nonlinear layers to produce segmentation plus pixel-wise uncertainty for self-assessing reliability under noisy or out-of-distribution inputs.
